_comment: CAMBER role <-> open-fdd point mapping for the G36 cross-check (#22 item 1). Versioned: bump `version` whenever a row, a scale or a rule id changes, and say why in `changes`. `pandas` is the open-fdd pandas cookbook column name (open_fdd.rules), `sql` the point_role written to columns.csv for the SQL engine (fdd_cli). Percent signals are handed to open-fdd as 0-1 fractions: open-fdd normalises each VALUE (a value above 1 is divided by 100), so a percent signal that dips to 0.5 % would otherwise be read as 50 %. Roles not listed are not passed. AIRFLOW is deliberately unmapped: open-fdd's FC6 compares the OA fraction with a design minimum OA flow (min_cfm_design) that the LBNL inventory does not give, and CAMBER's FC6 is likewise declined without a design minimum OA, so FC6 stays not evaluated in every engine.

fallbacks.why: open-fdd's FC2, FC3 and FC5 require a fan command; a 0/1 run status is a valid on/off command (fan_on_min is 0.01)

substitutions.when: no heat_valve is mapped (an AHU without a heating coil)
substitutions.why: G36 lets MAT and SAT stand in for the cooling-coil entering and leaving temperatures depending on the AHU configuration; CAMBER's g36_afdd makes the same substitution on a cooling-only AHU, and open-fdd's SQL FC14 falls back to MAT/SAT by itself. Without it the pandas FC14 is not evaluated

substitutions.when: no heat_valve is mapped (an AHU without a heating coil)
